I am renting this small piece of land in Mzimba, so I must be careful with money. Maize is our food, so I will buy a little fertilizer through the AIP subsidy if I can get a coupon — maybe one bag of Urea and one of NPK, which is not much for this plot. I will plant hybrid seed because the rains have been poor and I need a variety that matures faster, and I will intercrop with pumpkins and beans like my mother taught me. I cannot afford pesticide or irrigation; I will weed myself with my hoe and ask my younger sister to help at planting and harvest.
